# Song of Solomon Chapter 7 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Song of Solomon Chapter 7 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 7:10 — "his desire" (teshuqah)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "upon-me [is] his-desire [teshuqato]" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "his desire is for me" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "he desires me!" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS — preserves *teshuqah* allusion.

**Status:** All resolved.
